The '''Onderon Resistance''', or '''Onderon underground''', referred to the local resistance movement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], they assisted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Attack on the Imperial Army-Navy Ordnance Center|attack]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Jyrenne Base|military ordnance center]] on Onderon. They made heroic efforts to destroy the [[sensor net]]s and [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] before the Rebel attack, allowing the Rebels ships to destroy the base with minimal loses.
